title: Rest times your way
summary: Hide rest times between sets, swipe away individual rests with Undo, and choose a 30-second rest or no rest.
changes: Show rest times sits beside Rest timer in Settings > Timers & notifications. Hide the rows between sets in the logger without changing saved rests or the automatic countdown setting.
Swipe left on an individual rest time to remove it without deleting the set. The temporary popup at the bottom offers Undo; the remove button does the same.
Rest choices include 0:30 and 0:00 (no rest). Choosing 0:00 removes the rest and offers Undo.
After Undo expires, edit the set, choose Rest after set and save with the tick to add its rest back. Removed rests stay removed when the workout is saved or reopened.

image.alt: Settings with the Show rest times switch directly below Rest timer, so between-set rows and automatic countdowns can be controlled separately.
